faceSettings.title: Face recognition
faceSettings.experimental: <bold>Experimental</bold> — face recognition is still being refined. Grouping isn't perfect, so expect to merge or rename people now and then.
faceSettings.enabledNotice: Face recognition on for "{{name}}" — scanning has started. Follow progress under Control panel → Overview → Tasks.
faceSettings.rescanNotice: Full rescan started for "{{name}}". People update as photos are reprocessed — follow progress under Control panel → Overview → Tasks.
faceSettings.regroupingNotice: Regrouping… the first time also prepares face thumbnails, so it can take a minute. Reopen the People tab to see the result.
faceSettings.intro: Find faces in your photos and group the same person together — entirely on this server, nothing is sent to the internet. Turn it on per library.
faceSettings.unreadableHint: These photos could not be read (corrupt or unsupported files) and are skipped. A rescan tries them again.
faceSettings.strengthDesc: Lower = stricter: fewer different people wrongly merged, but more small groups to combine. Higher = more consolidated (8, the default). Applies to every library.
faceSettings.noLibrariesEnabledBody: Turn on face recognition for a library on the Libraries tab, then come back here to tune how strongly faces are grouped.
faceSettings.rescanConfirmBody: This rebuilds the automatic face groups for this library from scratch. Your person names, manual tags, and the photos you've removed from named people are kept.
faceSettings.clearConfirmBody1: This permanently deletes every detected face, automatic grouping, and face tag for <bold>{{name}}</bold>. People made up only of this library's faces will disappear from the People tab.
faceSettings.clearConfirmBody2: <bold>Your photos are not deleted</bold>, and named people who also appear in other libraries are kept. You can run face recognition again later to rebuild the groups.
faceSettings.checkingBody: Checking every person for likely duplicates… this can take a few seconds on a big library.
faceSettings.noPeopleBody: Turn on face recognition and run a scan first — there are no groups to check yet.
faceSettings.summaryTwinHint: — another cluster that's probably the same person.
faceSettings.explain: These pairs sit just under the automatic merge line ({{mergeLine}}) — grouping is deliberately cautious, so one person can end up split across clusters. A big pile-up here means it's under-merging. Merge the suggestions below to consolidate them; your names and manual fixes are kept.
faceSettings.wellMergedBody: No likely-duplicate clusters found — grouping isn't obviously under-merging.

shareAlbum.title: Share “{{name}}”
shareAlbum.linkIntro: Anyone with the link can view and download this album’s photos — no account needed. The link stays in step with the album: photos you add or remove appear and disappear automatically.
shareAlbum.copyNowHint: Copy this link now — it won’t be shown again.
shareAlbum.noLinks: No active links for this album.
shareAlbum.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy the link manually.
shareAlbum.peopleIntro: Who has their own live copy under “Shared with me” — always the album’s current photos, even ones in a library they can’t otherwise browse. To give somebody access, use <bold>Send to</bold>: pick them and it grants access as it tells them.
shareAlbum.noRecipients: Nobody has been given access to this album yet.

titleCard.title: Title & credits
titleCard.subtitle: How the movie opens and ends.
titleCard.previewAltOpening: Preview of the movie’s title card
titleCard.previewAltClosing: Preview of the movie’s closing card
titleCard.previewFailed: The preview couldn’t be drawn. The movie will still render.
titleCard.disabledOpening: No title card — the movie opens straight on the first photo.
titleCard.disabledClosing: No closing card — the movie ends on the last photo.
titleCard.titleEmptyHint: Leave it empty to use the slideshow’s name.
titleCard.openToggleAria: Open the movie with a title card
titleCard.closeToggleAria: End the movie with a closing card
titleCard.openCrossfadeHint: It cross-fades into the first photo with the slideshow’s own transition.
titleCard.closeSilenceHint: The music fades out underneath it, and the movie ends in silence.
titleCard.clipSoundHint: The music pauses while it plays, then picks up where it left off.
titleCard.closingClipHint: Plays last of all: after the closing card if you have one, otherwise straight after the last photo. Up to 20 seconds of it.
titleCard.customLinesAria: Your own lines under the title
titleCard.sixLinesHint: Up to six lines — each on its own row.
titleCard.creditsPlaceholder:
Filmed by Mum & Dad
Music: our song
titleCard.sixLinesHintClosing: Up to six lines — each on its own row. Leave it empty for just the end title.
titleCard.sizeHint: Shared by both cards. A long title still shrinks to fit the frame.
titleCard.closingFadeHint: The music fades out over the card (up to 8 seconds of fade).
titleCard.noPhotoBody: This slideshow has only videos, and a video can’t be used as a background. The card will be drawn on black until you add a photo.

black.label: Black
black.hint: White text on a plain black frame.

photo.label: A photo
photo.hint: One slide fills the frame, darkened behind the words.

blur.label: Blurred photo
blur.hint: The same slide, blurred — colour and mood without a competing subject.

collage.label: Collage
collage.hint: A grid tiled from photos spread across the whole slideshow.

classic.label: Classic
classic.hint: The face every movie uses today — clean and neutral.

serif.label: Serif
serif.hint: A book feel — suits anniversaries and quiet slideshows.

bold.label: Bold
bold.hint: Poster weight — carries a short title across a bright collage.

script.label: Script
script.hint: Handwritten — birthdays, weddings, the family occasions.

typewriter.label: Typewriter
typewriter.hint: Archival — old scans and home-movie collections.

movieLibrary.title: Where this movie is saved
movieLibrary.body: A finished movie can be filed into one of your galleries, so it sits with your photos instead of only living in this editor. Off unless you choose a library.
movieLibrary.dontSave: Don't save it to a library
movieLibrary.noneTitle: No library can take a movie
movieLibrary.noneBody: Saving a movie needs a gallery library you can add to, whose folder isn't read-only.
movieLibrary.reasonPermission: you can't add to this one
movieLibrary.ownHint: This replaces the copy already there, so you don't collect one movie per render.
movieLibrary.freeHint: The name is free. Re-rendering replaces this file rather than adding another.
movieLibrary.clashFileBody: A file of that name is already in this folder, but nothing in your gallery points at it. Keep both to save alongside it, or overwrite it.
movieLibrary.clashItemTitle: “{{name}}” is a video in your gallery
movieLibrary.clashItemBody: Saving over “{{title}}” would delete it, so that isn't offered. Rename this movie, or keep both.
movieLibrary.savedNotice: Saved the movie to your gallery as {{name}}.
movieLibrary.unableToSave: Unable to change where this movie is saved
movieLibrary.takenHint: That name is taken, so this would be saved as {{name}} instead.
